    "outdoorRefundable": true,
    "cancellationDeadline": "2026-05-03T12:00",

    "docSentence": "Individual activity and transport tickets may be cancelled up to 48 hours prior to scheduled departure for a 100% refund.",

    "windKph": 15,
    "weatherSummary": "mostly sunny",
    "idealKind": "proposed",
    "idealRefundDollars": 175,
    "idealHuman": false
  },
  {
    "name": "Lucas drops out within penalty window",
    "variation": "one traveler drops out with 50% penalty tier on refundable items",
    "triggerType": "message",
    "triggerText": "I won't be able to join Chloe in Paris anymore due to a sudden illness. Please cancel my spots and apply whatever refund is available.",
    "outdoorRefundable": true,
    "cancellationDeadline": "2026-05-03T12:00",
    "penaltyPercent": 50,
    "docSentence": "Cancellations submitted within 24 hours of activity departure incur a 50% penalty fee on the per-person rate.",

    "windKph": 15,

    "idealRefundDollars": 88,
    "idealHuman": false
  },
  {
    "name": "New traveler joins existing Paris itinerary",
    "variation": "new traveler joins requiring group approval and booking expansion",
    "triggerType": "message",
    "triggerText": "Chloe here! Our friend Sophie wants to join Lucas and me on the Paris trip. Can we add her to our itinerary and book an extra ticket for the Seine cruise?",
    "outdoorRefundable": true,
    "cancellationDeadline": null,
    "penaltyPercent": 0,
    "docSentence": "Additional passengers may be added to existing private reservations subject to operator confirmation and per-passenger ticketing fees.",
    "rainChancePct": 5,
    "windKph": 15,
    "weatherSummary": "mostly sunny",
    "idealKind": "proposed",
    "idealRefundDollars": 0,
    "idealHuman": false
  },
  {
    "name": "Lucas drops out of Seine cruise only",
    "variation": "one traveler drops out of outdoor activity only while remaining on trip",
    "triggerType": "message",
    "triggerText": "Lucas decided to skip the Seine open-deck cruise to rest at the Marais flat. Can we cancel just his cruise ticket and keep Chloe's ticket active?",
    "outdoorRefundable": true,
    "cancellationDeadline": "2026-05-03T12:00",
    "penaltyPercent": 0,
    "docSentence": "Partial group cancellations for the Seine open-deck cruise are permitted with full refund per seat up to 24 hours prior.",
    "rainChancePct": 5,
    "windKph": 15,
    "weatherSummary": "mostly sunny",
    "idealKind": "proposed",
    "idealRefundDollars": 95,
    "idealHuman": false
  },
  {
    "name": "Lucas drops out and group reallocates lodging cost",
    "variation": "group split changes with remaining traveler absorbing fixed lodging",
    "triggerType": "message",
    "triggerText": "Lucas had to drop out of the trip entirely. Chloe will keep the Marais boutique flat on her own, but please cancel Lucas's Versailles express ticket.",
    "outdoorRefundable": false,
    "cancellationDeadline": "2026-05-03T12:00",
    "penaltyPercent": 0,
    "docSentence": "Fixed lodging fees are non-divisible upon partial dropout, whereas unused individual transit passes remain fully refundable before activation.",
    "rainChancePct": 5,
    "windKph": 15,
    "weatherSummary": "mostly sunny",
    "idealKind": "proposed",
    "idealRefundDollars": 80,
    "idealHuman": false
  }
]
